title: MenACYW conjugate vaccine in healthy volunteers: NOT POOLABLE -- COMPARATOR + OUTCOME
topic_state: NOT POOLABLE -- decided from the registrations
verification_basis: Both registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: conditions, arm groups with types, registered primary outcome measures, and posted results.

handbook_authority.handbook: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions
handbook_authority.c62: 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.poolable_reason: TWO TRIALS THAT SHARE NEITHER A COMPARATOR NOR AN OUTCOME. Registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18. NCT03537508 compares the MenACYW conjugate vaccine against MENVEO; NCT03691610 compares it against different meningococcal polysaccharide preparations across four groups. DIFFERENT COMPARATOR VACCINES MEAN DIFFERENT QUESTIONS -- the same shape that closed the azilsartan topic in cardiology. The outcome compounds it: both register PERCENTAGE SERORESPONSE, but seroresponse is reported SEPARATELY FOR EACH OF FOUR SEROGROUPS (A, C, Y, W), so there is no single quantity to pool, and the two trials stratify by different age bands -- NCT03537508 from 42 days, NCT03691610 from 6 months, with group structures that do not correspond. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor -- each is registered and reports its own primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective; both lenacapavir trials in fact report striking results on their own terms. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that the question this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials this page carries. THE CRITICISM IS OF THE POOLING AND OF NOTHING ELSE. The registry is a live document and this reads its contents on 2026-08-18; a later amendment could change it.
primary.what_a_poolable_version_would_need: A shared comparator vaccine, a single named serogroup, and corresponding age strata. Each is available in principle; none is available across THESE two registrations.
primary.an_immunogenicity_caveat_worth_recording: Seroresponse percentage is a surrogate. Even a well-formed pool of it would not estimate protection against meningococcal disease, and a page titled for healthy volunteers should not be read as reporting one.

risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades trials contributing to a pooled result; this page publishes none.
